# Megicode

Megicode builds AI automation, AI SaaS MVPs, custom web apps, booking systems, dashboards, portals, and technical roadmaps for startups, non-technical founders, clinics, agencies, and growing businesses.

## Positioning

Megicode is best for buyers who need a practical software partner, not generic development. The company focuses on workflow clarity, shipped proof, reliable delivery, and measurable business outcomes.
